Title: Azov
Blurb: The Ottoman Empire cedes Azov to the Tsardom of Russia by the Treaty of Constantinople.

Title: Baltic Sea
Blurb: Great Northern War between the Russian and Swedish Empires, from 1700 to 1721.

Title: Maratha Empire
Blurb: Shivaji II was crowned 4th Chhatrapati of the Maratha empire under the Regency of Tarabai.

Title: Kingdom of Spain
Blurb: With the beginning of Philip V's reign over the Kingdom of Spain, Spain and its territories cease to be part of the Habsburg monarchy.

Title: Duchy of Mecklenburg
Blurb: The Duchy of Mecklenburg is divided into Mecklenburg-Schwerin and Mecklenburg-Strelitz.

Title: Europe
Blurb: The War of the Spanish Succession is fought, involving most of continental Europe, from 1701 to 1714.

Title: Feyiase
Blurb: The Battle of Feyiase marks the rise of the Ashanti Empire.

Title: Kingdom of Prussia
Blurb: Kingdom of Prussia declared under King Frederick I.

Title: Kumasi
Blurb: The Ashanti Empire is established in West Africa. Kumasi is the capital.

Title: France
Blurb: Camisard rebellion in France, from 1702 to 1715.

Title: Habsburg monarchy
Blurb: The Rakoczi uprising against the Habsburg monarchy, from 1703 to 1711.

Title: Saint Petersburg
Blurb: Saint Petersburg is founded by Peter the Great; it is the Russian capital until 1918.

Title: Baghdad
Blurb: The Mamluk dynasty in Iraq is established. Baghdad is the capital.

Title: Japan
Blurb: End of Japan's Genroku period.

Title: Java
Blurb: First Javanese War of Succession.

Title: Nassau
Blurb: The Kingdom of France and Spanish Empire take control of Nassau from the English, but soon abandon the city, returning control to the English.

Title: Luneburg and Saxe-Lauenburg
Blurb: The Electorate of Hanover receives the Principality of Luneburg and the Duchy of Saxe-Lauenburg.

Title: Ramillies
Blurb: The War of the Spanish Succession: French troops defeated at the Battle of Ramillies and the Siege of Turin, from 1706 to 1713.

Title: Saxony and Poland-Lithuania
Blurb: End of the personal union between the Electorate of Saxony and Poland-Lithuania.

Title: Kingdom of Great Britain
Blurb: The Act of Union is passed, merging the Scottish and English Parliaments, thus establishing the Kingdom of Great Britain.

Title: Lan Xang
Blurb: Lan Xang in Laos disintegrates into three parts: the Kingdom of Luang Phrabang in the north, the Kingdom of Vientiane in the middle, and the Kingdom of Champasak in the south.

Title: Mughal Empire
Blurb: Death of Mughal Emperor Aurangzeb leads to the fragmentation of the Mughal Empire.

Title: Kingdom of Valencia
Blurb: The Crown of Castile integrates the Kingdom of Valencia part of the Crown of Aragon through invasion (Battle of Almansa).

Title: Crown of Castile
Blurb: The Nueva Planta decrees abolish the Crown of Castile and make it part of the centralized Kingdom of Spain.

Title: East Prussia
Blurb: Famine kills one-third of East Prussia's population, from 1708 to 1709.

Title: Maratha Empire
Blurb: Shahu was crowned the 5th and the last hereditary Chhatrapati of Maratha empire, after a power struggle between him and the regent Tarabai.

Title: United Company of Merchants of England Trading to the East Indies
Blurb: The Company of Merchants of London Trading into the East Indies and English Company Trading to the East Indies merge to form the United Company of Merchants of England Trading to the East Indies.

Title: Hotak Empire
Blurb: Foundation of the Hotak Empire.

Title: Poltava
Blurb: The Great Frost of 1709 marks the coldest winter in 500 years, contributing to the defeat of Sweden at Poltava.

Title: Saxony and Poland-Lithuania
Blurb: Second personal union between the Electorate of Saxony and Poland-Lithuania.

Title: Azov
Blurb: Ottoman Empire fights Russia in the Russo-Turkish War and regains Azov, from 1710 to 1711.

Title: Statute of Anne
Blurb: The world's first copyright legislation, Britain's Statute of Anne, takes effect.

Title: Bukhara Khanate
Blurb: Bukhara Khanate dissolves as local begs seize power.

Title: Cap-Francois
Blurb: Cap-Francois becomes the capital of the French colony of Saint-Domingue.

Title: Duchy of Mirandola
Blurb: The Duchy of Mirandola becomes part of the Duchy of Modena and Reggio.

Title: North Carolina
Blurb: Tuscarora War between British, Dutch, and German settlers and the Tuscarora people of North Carolina, from 1711 to 1715.

Title: Principality of Transylvania
Blurb: The Principality of Transylvania is integrated de jure into the Habsburg monarchy as a crown land.

Title: Azov
Blurb: The Tsardom of Russia returns Azov to the Ottoman Empire by the Treaty of the Pruth.

Title: Carolina Colony
Blurb: The Carolina Colony is split into the North Carolina Colony and the South Carolina Colony.

Title: Saint Petersburg
Blurb: The Tsardom of Russia moves its capital from Moscow to Saint Petersburg.

Title: Qing China
Blurb: The Kangxi Emperor acknowledges the full recovery of the Chinese economy since its apex during the Ming.

Title: Gibraltar, Menorca, Sicily and Milan
Blurb: The Treaty of Utrecht is signed. Great Britain gains Gibraltar and Menorca from Spain; Spain cedes Sicily and part of Milan to Savoy, the Spanish Netherlands, Naples, Sardinia and most of Milan to Emperor Charles VI, and lands between the Amazon and Oiapoque to Portugal.

Title: Kaiserslautern, Landau and Breisgau
Blurb: The Kingdom of France conquers Kaiserslautern, Landau, and Breisgau.

Title: Electorate of Hanover
Blurb: The Electorate of Hanover enters into a personal union with the Kingdom of Great Britain.

Title: Freiburg im Breisgau
Blurb: The Habsburg monarchy receives Freiburg im Breisgau and several other small territories on its eastern borders from France, but France keeps Landau.

Title: Mercury-in-glass thermometer
Blurb: In Amsterdam, Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit invents the mercury-in-glass thermometer, which remains the most reliable and accurate thermometer until the electronic era.

Title: Milan, Sardinia, Naples and the Spanish Netherlands
Blurb: The Duchy of Milan, the Kingdom of Sardinia, the Kingdom of Naples, and the Spanish Netherlands are ceded by the Kingdom of Spain to the Habsburg monarchy.

Title: Austrian Netherlands
Blurb: The Austrian Netherlands follow the Spanish Netherlands. Brussels is the capital.

Title: Principality of Catalonia
Blurb: Fall of the Crown of Aragon, invaded by the Crown of Castile, marked by the Siege of Barcelona and the annexation of the Principality of Catalonia. A unified Kingdom of Spain is created through the Nueva Planta decrees.

Title: Colonia del Sacramento
Blurb: The Kingdom of Spain returns Colonia del Sacramento to the Kingdom of Portugal.

Title: Mauritius
Blurb: The Kingdom of France annexes Mauritius after the Dutch abandon it.

Title: Sheriffmuir
Blurb: The first Jacobite rising breaks out; the British halt the Jacobite advance at the Battle of Sheriffmuir; Battle of Preston.

Title: Kingdom of Majorca
Blurb: Spain integrates the Kingdom of Majorca, the last part of the Crown of Aragon, through invasion.

Title: Austro-Venetian-Turkish War
Blurb: Austro-Venetian-Turkish War, from 1716 to 1718.

Title: Sikh Confederacy
Blurb: Establishment of the Sikh Confederacy along the present-day India-Pakistan border.

Title: Bishopric of Courland
Blurb: The former Bishopric of Courland, until then in personal union with the Duchy of Courland and Semigallia (itself a vassal state of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth), comes into personal union directly with Poland-Lithuania.

Title: Viceroyalty of New Granada
Blurb: The Viceroyalty of New Granada is established from parts of the Viceroyalty of Peru as an overseas territory of the Kingdom of Spain.

Title: Banat of Temeswar
Blurb: The Banat of Temeswar is established as a Habsburg crown land (Treaty of Passarowitz).

Title: Dalmatia
Blurb: The Ottoman Empire cedes parts of Dalmatia (Imotski, Sinj, and Vrgorac).

Title: Kingdom of Serbia
Blurb: The Kingdom of Serbia is established as a Habsburg crown land (Treaty of Passarowitz).

Title: Morea and Crete
Blurb: Venice returns Morea (gained by the Treaty of Karlowitz) and its Cretan holdings to the Ottomans.

Title: Ottoman Empire
Blurb: Tulip period of the Ottoman Empire, from 1718 to 1730.

Title: Quadruple Alliance
Blurb: War of the Quadruple Alliance with Spain versus France, Britain, Austria, and the Netherlands, from 1718 to 1720.

Title: Banat, Syrmia, Serbia and Oltenia
Blurb: The Ottoman Empire cedes to the Habsburg monarchy the territories of Banat, southeastern Syrmia, central Serbia, part of northern Bosnia, and part of Wallachia (an Ottoman vassal) known as Oltenia (Treaty of Passarowitz).

Title: Java
Blurb: Second Javanese War of Succession.

Title: Bremen-Verden
Blurb: Sweden cedes Bremen-Verden to the Electorate of Hanover.

Title: Kingdom of Sardinia
Blurb: The Duchy of Savoy receives the Kingdom of Sardinia from the Habsburg monarchy in exchange for Sicily.

Title: Mannheim
Blurb: The Electorate of the Palatinate moves its capital from Dusseldorf to Mannheim.

Title: Marseille
Blurb: The Great Plague of Marseille, from 1720 to 1721.

Title: South Sea Company
Blurb: The South Sea Bubble.

Title: Tibet
Blurb: Qing forces oust Dzungar invaders from Tibet.

Title: Swedish Pomerania
Blurb: Sweden cedes the portion of Swedish Pomerania south of the Peene and east of the Peenestrom to Prussia.

Title: Nystad
Blurb: The Treaty of Nystad is signed, ending the Great Northern War.

Title: Shamakhi
Blurb: Sack of Shamakhi, massacre of its Shia population by Sunni Lezgins.

Title: Estonia, Ingria, Livonia and Karelia
Blurb: Swedish Estonia, Ingria, Livonia, and most of Karelia is ceded by Sweden to the Tsardom of Russia according to the terms of the Treaty of Nystad.

Title: Ireland
Blurb: Controversy over William Wood's halfpence leads to the Drapier's Letters and begins the Irish economic independence from England movement, from 1722 to 1725.

Title: Isfahan
Blurb: Siege of Isfahan results in the handover of Iran to the Hotaki Afghans.

Title: Russo-Persian War
Blurb: Russo-Persian War, from 1722 to 1723.

Title: Dzungaria
Blurb: The Qing and the Dzungars fight a series of wars across Qinghai, Dzungaria, and Outer Mongolia, with inconclusive results, from 1723 to 1732.

Title: Kazakh Khanate
Blurb: The Great Disaster, an invasion of Kazakh territories by the Dzungars, from 1723 to 1730.

Title: Russia
Blurb: Slavery is abolished in Russia; Peter the Great converts household slaves into house serfs.

Title: Viceroyalty of New Granada
Blurb: The Viceroyalty of New Granada again becomes part of the Viceroyalty of Peru.

Title: Fahrenheit scale
Blurb: Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit proposes the Fahrenheit temperature scale.

Title: Austro-Spanish alliance
Blurb: Austro-Spanish alliance revived. Russia joins in 1726.

Title: Anglo-Spanish War
Blurb: Anglo-Spanish War ends inconclusively, from 1727 to 1729.

Title: Godthab
Blurb: On Greenland (then part of Denmark-Norway), Hans Egede founds the colony of Godthab.

Title: Great Britain and North America
Blurb: The First Great Awakening takes place in Great Britain and North America, from 1730 to 1760.

Title: Ottoman Empire
Blurb: Mahmud I takes over Ottoman Empire after the Patrona Halil revolt, ending the Tulip period.

Title: Georgia Colony
Blurb: The Georgia Colony is founded in British North America. Savannah is the capital.

Title: Russia
Blurb: Crimean Tatar raids into Russia, from 1732 to 1734.

Title: Poland
Blurb: War of the Polish Succession, from 1733 to 1738.

Title: Austro-Russo-Turkish War
Blurb: Austro-Russo-Turkish War, from 1735 to 1739.

Title: Qing China
Blurb: The Qianlong Emperor of China oversees a huge expansion in territory, from 1735 to 1799.

Title: Mashhad
Blurb: The Afsharid dynasty is established in Persia and follows the Safavid dynasty. Mashhad is the capital.

Title: Belem
Blurb: The Kingdom of Portugal moves the capital of its colonial State of Maranhao from Sao Luis to Belem.

Title: Kandahar
Blurb: Hotak Empire ends after the siege of Kandahar by Nader Shah, from 1737 to 1738.

Title: Hotak dynasty
Blurb: The Hotak dynasty is disestablished.

Title: Naples, Sicily, Lorraine and Parma
Blurb: The Habsburg Monarchy loses Naples and Sicily to Charles of Parma, Lorraine to Stanislaus Leszczynski, Parma to Austria and Tuscany to Francis Stephen, while the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth loses direct control over Courland and Semigallia.

Title: Timbuktu
Blurb: Famine across the Sahel; half the population of Timbuktu dies, from 1738 to 1756.

Title: Bouvet Island
Blurb: Jean-Baptiste Charles Bouvet de Lozier discovers Bouvet Island in the South Atlantic Ocean.

Title: Caribbean
Blurb: Great Britain and Spain fight the War of Jenkins' Ear in the Caribbean.

Title: Karnal
Blurb: Nader Shah defeats a pan-Indian army of 300,000 at the Battle of Karnal. Taxation is stopped in Iran for three years.

Title: Oltenia
Blurb: The Habsburg monarchy returns Oltenia to Wallachia (Treaty of Belgrade).

Title: Sindh
Blurb: Nader Shah's Sindh expedition, from 1739 to 1740.

Title: Viceroyalty of New Granada
Blurb: The Viceroyalty of New Granada is again separated from the Viceroyalty of Peru.

Title: Serbia, Banat and northern Bosnia
Blurb: The Habsburg monarchy cedes the Kingdom of Serbia, the southern part of the Banat of Temeswar, and northern Bosnia to the Ottoman Empire (Treaty of Belgrade).

Title: Austria
Blurb: War of the Austrian Succession, from 1740 to 1748.

Title: Ireland
Blurb: Famine in Ireland kills 20 percent of the population, from 1740 to 1741.

Title: New England
Blurb: George Whitefield brings the First Great Awakening to New England.

Title: Oyo Empire
Blurb: The Oyo Empire is established in West Africa.

Title: Bengal
Blurb: Maratha invasions of Bengal, from 1741 to 1751.

Title: Uzbekistan, Khwarazm, Dagestan and Oman
Blurb: Iran invades Uzbekistan, Khwarazm, Dagestan, and Oman, from 1741 to 1743.

Title: Celsius scale
Blurb: Anders Celsius proposes an inverted form of the centigrade temperature, which is later renamed Celsius in his honor.

Title: Marvel's Mill
Blurb: Marvel's Mill, the first water-powered cotton mill, begins operation in England.

Title: Silesia
Blurb: Treaty of Berlin: Silesia is partitioned between Prussia and the House of Habsburg. Prussia receives the majority of Silesia while Austria retains a smaller area hence known as Austrian Silesia.

Title: Ottoman-Persian War
Blurb: Another Ottoman-Persian War involves 375,000 men but ultimately ends in a stalemate, from 1743 to 1746.

Title: Carnatic
Blurb: The First Carnatic War is fought between the British, the French, the Marathas, and Mysore in India, from 1744 to 1748.

Title: Kingdom of Matamba
Blurb: The Kingdom of Matamba is annexed to Portuguese Angola.

Title: Toulon
Blurb: Battle of Toulon is fought off the coast of France.

Title: Kingdom of Croatia-Slavonia
Blurb: The kingdoms of Croatia and Slavonia are unified into the Kingdom of Croatia-Slavonia within the Habsburg monarchy. Zagreb is the capital.

Title: Kingdom of Swaziland
Blurb: The Kingdom of Swaziland is established in southern Africa.

Title: Scotland
Blurb: Second Jacobite rising is begun by Charles Edward Stuart in Scotland.

Title: Culloden
Blurb: The extinction of the Scottish clan system came with the defeat of the clansmen at the Battle of Culloden in 1746.

Title: Durrani Empire
Blurb: The Durrani Empire is founded by Ahmad Shah Durrani.

Title: Safavid Empire
Blurb: The Safavid Empire collapses.

Title: Aix-la-Chapelle
Blurb: The Treaty of Aix-La-Chapelle ends the War of the Austrian Succession and First Carnatic War.

Title: Carnatic
Blurb: The Second Carnatic War is fought between the British, the French, the Marathas, and Mysore in India, from 1748 to 1754.

Title: Parma, Piacenza and Guastalla
Blurb: Duchies of Parma, Piacenza, and Guastalla ceded to the Spanish Bourbons (Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle).

Title: Maratha Empire
Blurb: The death of Chhatrapati Shahu leads to the peshwa's taking power over the Maratha throne.

Title: Little Ice Age
Blurb: Peak of the Little Ice Age.

Title: Brazilian interior
Blurb: Spain and Portugal sign the Treaty of Madrid. On the uti possidetis principle Portugal gains lands in the present south, central and north of Brazil; Spain receives Colonia del Sacramento and Portugal the Misiones Orientales.

Title: Shiraz
Blurb: Karim Khan establishes the Zand dynasty in Persia. Shiraz is the capital.

Title: State of Great-Para and Maranhao
Blurb: The Kingdom of Portugal changes the name of its colonial State of Maranhao to State of Great-Para and Maranhao.

Title: Sweden-Norway border
Blurb: Through the Treaty of Stromstad, the border between Sweden and Norway is finally settled, from the beginning of the land border in Iddefjord until Norway's border on Russia at Varanger.

Title: British Empire
Blurb: The British Empire adopts the Gregorian Calendar, skipping 11 days from 3 September to 13 September. On the calendar, 2 September is followed directly by 14 September.

Title: Shwebo
Blurb: Establishment of the Konbaung dynasty in Burma. Shwebo is the capital.

Title: Menorca
Blurb: During the Seven Years' War, France occupies the island of Menorca.

Title: King's College
Blurb: King's College is founded by a royal charter of George II of Great Britain.
Place: New York, New York, United States

Title: North America
Blurb: The French and Indian War, the North American chapter of the Seven Years' War, is fought in colonial North America, mostly by the French and their allies against the English and their allies, from 1754 to 1763.

Title: Pondicherry
Blurb: The Treaty of Pondicherry ends the Second Carnatic War and recognizes Muhammed Ali Khan Wallajah as Nawab of the Carnatic.

Title: Lisbon
Blurb: The great Lisbon earthquake destroys most of Portugal's capital and kills up to 100,000.

Title: Nova Scotia
Blurb: The Great Upheaval forces transfer of the French Acadian population from Nova Scotia and New Brunswick, from 1755 to 1763.

Title: Puning Temple
Blurb: The tallest wooden Bodhisattva statue in the world is erected at Puning Temple, Chengde, China.

Title: Xinjiang
Blurb: The Dzungar genocide depopulates much of northern Xinjiang, allowing for Han, Uyghur, Khalkha Mongol, and Manchu colonization.

Title: Carnatic
Blurb: The Third Carnatic War is fought between the British, the French, and Mysore in India, from 1756 to 1763.

Title: Bengal
Blurb: British conquest of Bengal.

Title: Dzungar Khanate
Blurb: The Dzungar Khanate is annexed by the Qing dynasty of China.

Title: Senegambia
Blurb: The Kingdom of Great Britain conquers Senegambia from the Kingdom of France.

Title: Sultanate of Sulu
Blurb: The Sultanate of Sulu becomes independent from the Bruneian Empire.

Title: Kingdom of Great Britain
Blurb: George III becomes King of Britain.

Title: Marine chronometer
Blurb: The problem of longitude was finally resolved by the fourth chronometer of John Harrison.

Title: Panipat
Blurb: Maratha Empire defeated at Battle of Panipat.

Title: Treaty of Madrid
Blurb: The Kingdom of Spain and the Kingdom of Portugal sign the Treaty of El Pardo, nullifying the Treaty of Madrid.

Title: Russian Empire
Blurb: Reign of Catherine the Great of Russia, from 1762 to 1796.

Title: Louisiana Territory
Blurb: Following the end of the French and Indian War in North America, the Louisiana Territory is transferred from France to Spain in the secret Treaty of Fontainebleau.

Title: Bayes' theorem
Blurb: Thomas Bayes publishes first version of Bayes' theorem, paving the way for Bayesian probability.

Title: Paris
Blurb: The Treaty of Paris ends the Seven Years' War and Third Carnatic War.

Title: Saxony and Poland-Lithuania
Blurb: End of the second personal union between the Electorate of Saxony and Poland-Lithuania.

Title: Rio de Janeiro
Blurb: The Kingdom of Portugal moves the capital of its colony of the State of Brazil from Salvador to Rio de Janeiro.

Title: Atakpame
Blurb: Dahomey and the Oyo Empire defeat the Ashanti army at the Battle of Atakpame.

Title: Buxar
Blurb: The Mughals are defeated at the Battle of Buxar.

Title: Ayutthaya
Blurb: The Burmese invade Thailand and utterly destroy Attuthaya, from 1765 to 1767.

Title: Burma
Blurb: Burma under Hsinbyushin repels four invasions from Qing China, securing hegemony over the Shan states, from 1765 to 1769.

Title: Grand Duchy of Transylvania
Blurb: The Grand Duchy of Transylvania follows the Principality of Transylvania.

Title: Thirteen Colonies
Blurb: The Stamp Act is introduced into the American colonies by the British Parliament.

Title: Watt steam engine
Blurb: James Watt enhances Newcomen's steam engine, allowing new steel technologies.

Title: Denmark
Blurb: Christian VII becomes king of Denmark. He was king of Denmark to 1808.

Title: Duchy of Lorraine
Blurb: France annexes the Duchy of Lorraine.

Title: Mysore
Blurb: Anglo-Mysore Wars, from 1766 to 1799.

Title: Falkland Islands
Blurb: The Falkland Islands start depending from the Governorate of Buenos Aires instead of the Kingdom of Chile.

Title: Ayutthaya
Blurb: Ayutthaya, capital of the Ayutthaya Kingdom, is destroyed during the Burmese-Siamese War. The Thonburi Kingdom follows the Ayutthaya Kingdom in Siam.

Title: Thailand
Blurb: Taksin expels Burmese invaders and reunites Thailand under an authoritarian regime.

Title: Bar Confederation
Blurb: War of the Bar Confederation, from 1768 to 1772.

Title: Pacific Ocean
Blurb: James Cook mapped the boundaries of the Pacific Ocean and discovered many Pacific Islands, from 1768 to 1779.

Title: Russo-Turkish War
Blurb: Russo-Turkish War, from 1768 to 1774.

Title: Corsica
Blurb: Genoa sells to France its rights to Corsica.

Title: Kathmandu
Blurb: Prithvi Narayan Shah unifies the Kingdom of Nepal. Kathmandu is the capital.

Title: Ambon
Blurb: French expeditions capture clove plants in Ambon, ending the Dutch East India Company's (VOC) monopoly of the plant.

Title: Bengal
Blurb: The Bengal famine of 1770 kills one-third of the Bengal population, from 1769 to 1773.

Title: California
Blurb: Spanish missionaries establish the first of 21 missions in California.

Title: Egypt
Blurb: Egypt breaks away from the Ottoman Empire and gains short-term independence, and Ali Bey al-Kabir declared the de facto ruler.

Title: French East India Company
Blurb: The French East India Company dissolves, only to be revived in 1785.

Title: New Zealand and Australia
Blurb: James Cook explores and maps New Zealand and Australia, from 1769 to 1770.

Title: Czech lands
Blurb: Famine in Czech lands kills hundreds of thousands, from 1770 to 1771.

Title: Hejaz
Blurb: Egyptians forces defeat the Ottoman Army in Campaigns in the Hejaz (1770).

Title: Port-au-Prince
Blurb: The capital of the French colony of Saint-Domingue is moved from Cap-Francois to Port-au-Prince.

Title: Australia
Blurb: James Cook reaches Australia and takes possession of the land for the Kingdom of Great Britain.

Title: Kalmyk Khanate
Blurb: The Kalmyk Khanate dissolves as the territory becomes colonized by Russians. More than a hundred thousand Kalmyks migrate back to Qing Dzungaria.

Title: Moscow
Blurb: The Plague Riot in Moscow.

Title: Putuo Zongcheng Temple
Blurb: The Chinese Putuo Zongcheng Temple of Chengde is completed, during the reign of the Qianlong Emperor.

Title: Maratha Empire
Blurb: Maratha Empire fights Britain and Raghunathrao's forces during the First Anglo-Maratha War, from 1772 to 1779.

Title: Poland-Lithuania
Blurb: First partition of Poland.

Title: State of Great-Para and State of Maranhao
Blurb: The Kingdom of Portugal divides its colony of the State of Great-Para and Maranhao into the State of Great-Para, with its capital at Belem, and the State of Maranhao, with its capital at Sao Luis.

Title: Sweden
Blurb: Gustav III of Sweden stages a coup d'etat, becoming almost an absolute monarch.

Title: Thonburi
Blurb: Following Ayutthaya's destruction in 1767, the new capital of Siam is created in Thonburi.

Title: Kingdom of Galicia and Lodomeria
Blurb: The Kingdom of Galicia and Lodomeria is founded as the crown land of the Habsburg monarchy. Lemberg is the capital.

Title: Bengal
Blurb: East India Company starts operations in Bengal to smuggle opium into China.

Title: Russia
Blurb: Pugachev's Rebellion, the largest peasant revolt in Russian history, from 1773 to 1775.

Title: Oxygen
Blurb: Joseph Priestley discovers dephlogisticated air, oxygen.

Title: Bukovina
Blurb: The Habsburg monarchy annexes the northwestern part of Moldavia (later known as Bukovina).

Title: Colony of Brazil
Blurb: The Kingdom of Portugal reunites its South American colonies of the State of Brazil, the State of Great-Para, and the State of Maranhao into the Colony of Brazil. Rio de Janeiro is the capital.

Title: Thirteen Colonies
Blurb: American Revolutionary War, from 1775 to 1783.

Title: Zaporizhian Cossacks
Blurb: Russia imposes a reduction in autonomy on the Zaporizhian Cossacks of Ukraine.

Title: Borneo
Blurb: Several kongsi republics are founded by Chinese settlers in the island of Borneo. They are some of the first democracies in Asia.

Title: Illuminati
Blurb: Illuminati founded by Adam Weishaupt.

Title: Kabul
Blurb: The Durrani Empire moves its capital from Kandahar to Kabul. The winter capital is Peshawar.

Title: South America
Blurb: A Spanish-Portuguese War occurs over land in the South American frontiers, from 1776 to 1777.

Title: The Wealth of Nations
Blurb: Adam Smith publishes The Wealth of Nations, foundation of the modern theory of economy.

Title: United States
Blurb: The United States Declaration of Independence is adopted by the Second Continental Congress in Philadelphia.

Title: Viceroyalty of the Rio de la Plata
Blurb: The Viceroyalty of the Rio de la Plata is separated from the Viceroyalty of Peru. The Kingdom of Chile loses the cities of Mendoza and San Juan (Cuyo Province). Buenos Aires is the capital.

Title: Nassau
Blurb: The American colonies occupy Nassau from the British during the American Revolutionary War.

Title: Nassau
Blurb: The American colonies abandon Nassau, returning control to the British during the American Revolutionary War.

Title: Rhode Island and Providence Plantations
Blurb: The Colony of Rhode Island and Providence Plantations declares its independence from the Kingdom of Great Britain. Providence is the capital.

Title: Baltimore
Blurb: The United States of America moves its temporary capital from Philadelphia to Baltimore.

Title: Republic of New Connecticut
Blurb: The Republic of New Connecticut declares its independence from the Kingdom of Great Britain. Westminster is the temporary capital.

Title: Philadelphia
Blurb: The United States of America moves its temporary capital back from Baltimore to Philadelphia.

Title: Windsor
Blurb: The Republic of New Connecticut moves its capital from Westminster to Windsor.

Title: Vermont Republic
Blurb: The Republic of New Connecticut changes its name to the Vermont Republic.

Title: Lancaster
Blurb: The United States of America moves its temporary capital from Philadelphia to Lancaster for one day, following the capture of Philadelphia by British forces.

Title: York
Blurb: The United States of America moves its temporary capital from Lancaster to York.

Title: Colonia del Sacramento and Misiones Orientales
Blurb: The Kingdom of Spain and the Kingdom of Portugal sign the First Treaty of San Ildefonso, confirming almost all the borders defined by the Treaty of Madrid, with the exception that Spain will rule both Colonia del Sacramento and the Misiones Orientales.

Title: Annobon and Bioko
Blurb: The Kingdom of Portugal cedes Annobon and Bioko to the Kingdom of Spain.

Title: Franco-American alliance
Blurb: Franco-American alliance signed.

Title: Hawaiian Islands
Blurb: James Cook becomes the first European to land on the Hawaiian Islands.

Title: Kingdom of Champasak
Blurb: The Kingdom of Champasak becomes a vassal state of Siam.

Title: Spanish Guinea
Blurb: Spain acquires its first permanent holding in Africa from the Portuguese, which is administered by the newly-established La Plata Viceroyalty.

Title: Tay Son dynasty
Blurb: Thai Duc establishes the Tay Son dynasty in Vietnam.

Title: Vietnam
Blurb: Vietnam is reunified for the first time in 200 years by the Tay Son brothers. The Tay Son dynasty has been established, terminating the Le dynasty.

Title: East Union
Blurb: The Vermont Republic claims the East Union, consisting of some towns in New Hampshire which had petitioned earlier in the year to join with Vermont. Vermont never gains full control over the area.

Title: Philadelphia
Blurb: The United States of America moves its temporary capital from York back to Philadelphia.

Title: East Union
Blurb: The Vermont Republic rescinds its claim to the East Union, consisting of some towns in New Hampshire.

Title: British Empire
Blurb: Britain loses several islands and colonial outposts all over the world to the combined Franco-Spanish navy, from 1779 to 1783.

Blurb: On 29 January Stamford Raffles arrives in Singapore with William Farquhar to establish a British East India Company trading post; on 8 February a treaty is signed with Sultan Hussein of Johor and Temenggong Abdul Rahman, and Farquhar becomes the first Resident.

Title: Antarctica
Blurb: 1820: Discovery of Antarctica.

Title: Lahaina
Blurb: The Kingdom of Hawaii establishes its capital at Lahaina.

Title: Liberia
Blurb: 1820: Liberia founded by the American Colonization Society for freed American slaves.

Title: Maratha Empire
Blurb: 1820: Dissolution of the Maratha Empire.

Title: Southern Europe
Blurb: Revolutions of 1820 in Southern Europe.

Title: Sultanate of Muscat and Oman
Blurb: The Sultanate of Muscat and Oman is established from the merger of the Sultanate of Muscat and the Imamate of Oman.

Title: Federal League
Blurb: The Federal League defeats the central government of the United Provinces of the Rio de la Plata at the Battle of Cepeda. The League is dissolved and the Argentine provinces resume their individual sovereignties, delegating foreign affairs to Buenos Aires.

Title: Kingdom of Haiti
Blurb: The Kingdom of Haiti collapses upon the suicide of King Henri I. Haiti is unified under the Republic of Haiti with its capital at Port-au-Prince.

Title: Alaska
Blurb: The Alaska Boundary Dispute between the Russian Empire and the United Kingdom begins.

Title: Federal Republic of Central America
Blurb: The Federal Republic of Central America gained independence from Spain in 1821 and from Mexico in 1823.

Title: First Mexican Empire
Blurb: 1821-1823: First Mexican Empire, as Mexico's first post-independence government, ruled by Emperor Agustin I of Mexico.

Title: Gold Coast
Blurb: The Gold Coast is established as a British colony.

Title: Greece
Blurb: Greek War of Independence against the Ottoman Empire, from 1821 to 1830.

Title: Spanish and American North America
Blurb: In the Adams-Onis Treaty, the United States of America and the Kingdom of Spain define a border between their North American possessions, leading to some land being swapped.

Title: Lisbon
Blurb: The United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves returns the capital from exile in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, to Lisbon.

Title: East Florida
Blurb: Spain formally cedes East Florida to the United States of America under the Adams-Onis Treaty.

Title: West Florida
Blurb: Spain formally cedes West Florida to the United States of America under the Adams-Onis Treaty.

Title: Cisplatina
Blurb: Cisplatina formally declares itself part of the United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves.

Title: Mexican Empire
Blurb: The Monarchy of Spain recognizes the independence of the Mexican Empire.

Title: Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua and El Salvador
Blurb: The Republic of Guatemala, the Republic of Honduras, the Republic of Nicaragua, and the Republic of El Salvador become independent from the Monarchy of Spain. Guatemala City, Comayagua, Managua, and San Salvador are the respective capitals.

Title: Panama
Blurb: Panama gains independence from the Monarchy of Spain.

Title: Panama
Blurb: Panama unites with Gran Colombia.

Title: Republic of Spanish Haiti
Blurb: The Republic of Spanish Haiti gains independence from the Monarchy of Spain. Santo Domingo is the capital.

Title: Republic of Spanish Haiti
Blurb: Haiti annexes the Republic of Spanish Haiti. Santo Domingo yields to Port-au-Prince as the capital.

Title: Peruvian Republic
Blurb: The Peruvian Republic supersedes the State of Peru.

Title: Burma
Blurb: British Empire annexed Burma (now also called Myanmar) after three Anglo-Burmese Wars, from 1823 to 1887.

Title: San Jose
Blurb: The Republic of Costa Rica moves its capital from Cartago to San Jose.

Title: United Mexican States
Blurb: The United Mexican States supersedes the Mexican Empire upon the execution of Agustin de Iturbide.

Title: Americas
Blurb: 1823: Monroe Doctrine declared by US President James Monroe.
Place: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

Title: Ninth Symphony
Blurb: 1824: Premiere of Beethoven's Ninth Symphony.

Title: Bolivia
Blurb: Bolivia declares independence from the Monarchy of Spain and refuses to join either Peru or the United Provinces of South America.

Title: South America
Blurb: The Battle of Ayacucho ends the Spanish American wars of independence in South America.

Title: Aluminium
Blurb: First isolation of aluminium.

Title: Dutch Caribbean colonies
Blurb: The Netherlands administratively combines its three colonies of Suriname, Curacao and Dependencies (the ABC islands), and Sint Eustatius and Dependencies (the SSS islands). The capital is Paramaribo.

Title: Erie Canal
Blurb: Erie Canal opened connecting the Great Lakes to the Atlantic Ocean.

Title: Java
Blurb: Java War begins, lasting from 1825 to 1830.

Title: Stockton and Darlington Railway
Blurb: The Stockton and Darlington Railway, the first public railway in the world, is opened.

Title: New South Wales
Blurb: The border of the British colony of New South Wales is extended from 133 degrees east to 129 degrees east.

Title: Cisplatina
Blurb: Cisplatina declares its independence from the Empire of Brazil and reunites with the United Provinces of the Rio de la Plata.

Title: Empire of Brazil
Blurb: The United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves recognizes the independence of the Empire of Brazil.

Title: Kingdom of Portugal and the Algarves
Blurb: The United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves changes its name back to the Kingdom of Portugal and the Algarves.

Title: Van Diemen's Land
Blurb: Van Diemen's Land is declared a separate British colony to New South Wales.

Title: Senate Square
Blurb: 1825: The Decembrist revolt. Decembrists gathered at the Senate Square.

Title: Assam, Manipur, Arakan and Tenasserim
Blurb: Following the First Anglo-Burmese War, Burma is forced to cede Assam, Manipur, Arakan, and Tenasserim to the British East India Company.

Title: British Malaya
Blurb: British Malaya is established and managed by the British East India Company.

Title: Duchy of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha
Blurb: The Duchy of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha is created from the merger of the Duchies of Saxe-Coburg and Saxe-Gotha. Coburg and Gotha are the respective capitals.

Title: Internal combustion engine
Blurb: Samuel Morey patents the internal combustion engine.

Title: Persian Empire
Blurb: After the final Russo-Persian War, the Persian Empire took back territory lost to Russia from the previous war, from 1826 to 1828.

Title: United Provinces of the Rio de la Plata
Blurb: The United Provinces of the Rio de la Plata is proclaimed as a centralist and unitary state.

Title: Republic of Chile
Blurb: The Republic of Chile supersedes the State of Chile.

Title: Straits Settlements
Blurb: The Straits Settlements administrative unit is established and managed by the British East India Company. It consists of Penang, Dinding, Malacca, and Singapore.

Title: Bonin Islands
Blurb: The United Kingdom claims the Bonin Islands.

Title: United Provinces of the Rio de la Plata
Blurb: The centralist and unitary state of the United Provinces of the Rio de la Plata is dissolved. The Argentine Provinces resume their individual sovereignties, delegating their representation in foreign affairs to the Province of Buenos Aires.

Title: Kingdom of Vientiane
Blurb: The Kingdom of Vientiane is annexed by Siam.

Title: Misiones Orientales
Blurb: The Misiones Orientales are awarded to the Empire of Brazil.

Title: Tasmania
Blurb: Black War in Tasmania leads to the near extinction of the Tasmanian aborigines, from 1828 to 1832.

Title: Oriental State of Uruguay
Blurb: The Banda Oriental gains independence from the United Provinces of the Rio de la Plata as the Government and Provisional General Captaincy of the Oriental State of Uruguay. Montevideo is the capital.

Title: Electric motor
Blurb: First electric motor built.

Title: Metropolitan Police Service
Blurb: 1829: Sir Robert Peel founds the Metropolitan Police Service, the first modern police force.

Title: Swan River Colony
Blurb: The British Swan River Colony is established in western Australia.

Title: Faust
Blurb: 1829: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe's Faust premieres.

Title: Afghanistan
Blurb: 1830: Anglo-Russian rivalry over Afghanistan, the Great Game, commences and concludes in 1895.

Title: Algeria
Blurb: French expansion resumed in the 19th century, beginning with the conquest of Algeria in 1830 and the establishment of influence in Africa.

Title: Belgium
Blurb: Belgian Revolution results in Belgium's independence from the Netherlands.

Title: Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints
Blurb: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints is established.

Title: Gran Colombia
Blurb: The post-colonial nation of Gran Colombia dissolved and the nations of Colombia (including modern-day Panama), Ecuador, and Venezuela took its place.

Title: Greece
Blurb: Greece became the first country to break away from the Ottoman Empire after the Greek War of Independence.

Title: House of Bourbon
Blurb: July Revolution overthrew the old line of Bourbons.

Title: Ireland
Blurb: From 1830 to 1914, almost 5 million Irish people emigrated to the U.S.

Title: Poland
Blurb: November Uprising in Poland against Russia.

Title: Regency of Algiers
Blurb: France conquers the Regency of Algiers from the Ottoman Empire.

Title: First Hellenic Republic
Blurb: The Ottoman Empire recognizes the independence of the First Hellenic Republic. Nafplio is the capital.

Title: Republic of Ecuador and Republic of Venezuela
Blurb: The Republic of Ecuador and the Republic of Venezuela declare independence from Gran Colombia. Quito and Caracas are the respective capitals.

Title: Unitarian League
Blurb: The Unitarian League is created among the Argentine provinces of San Luis, La Rioja, Catamarca, Mendoza, San Juan, Tucuman, Cordoba, Salta, and Santiago del Estero.

Title: Mataram
Blurb: End of the Java War. The whole area of Yogyakarta and Surakarta Manca nagara was seized by the Dutch. On 27 September the Klaten Agreement determined a fixed boundary between Surakarta and Yogyakarta and permanently divided the kingdom of Mataram.

Title: Algeria
Blurb: France invades and occupies Algeria.

Title: Argentine Confederation
Blurb: The Federal Pact is signed by the Province of Buenos Aires, the Province of Entre Rios, and the Province of Santa Fe, beginning the Argentine Confederation.

Title: Bosnia
Blurb: The Bosnian Uprising against Ottoman rule occurred.

Title: Greater Syria
Blurb: The First Egyptian-Ottoman War (1831-1833) begins, caused by Muhammad Ali Pasha's demand for control of Greater Syria as reward for aiding the Sultan in the Greek War of Independence. Egyptian forces temporarily take Syria, advancing as far north as Kutahya.

Title: HMS Beagle
Blurb: Charles Darwin's journey on HMS Beagle, from 1831 to 1836.

Title: British Guiana
Blurb: The United Kingdom combines Essequibo-Demerara and Berbice as the Crown Colony of British Guiana. Georgetown is the capital.

Title: Battle of Warsaw
Blurb: 1831: November Uprising ends with crushing defeat for Poland in the Battle of Warsaw.

Title: Republic of New Granada
Blurb: The Republic of New Granada supersedes Gran Colombia.

Title: Brazil
Blurb: Regimental rebellions of Brazil, from 1832 to 1875.

Title: British Parliament
Blurb: 1832: The British Parliament passes the Great Reform Act 1832.

Title: Konya
Blurb: The Battle of Konya is fought during the Egyptian-Ottoman War (1831-1833).

Title: Western Australia
Blurb: The colony of Western Australia supersedes the British Swan River Colony in Australia.

Title: Kingdom of Greece
Blurb: The Kingdom of Greece supersedes the First Hellenic Republic.

Title: Republic of Indian Stream
Blurb: The Republic of Indian Stream declares independence from both the United States of America and the United Kingdom, as it was disputed territory.

Title: Unitarian League
Blurb: The Province of Catamarca joins the Federal Pact. End of the Unitarian League.

Title: British Empire
Blurb: The Slavery Abolition Act 1833 banned slavery throughout the British Empire and charged the British Royal Navy with ending the global slave trade. The British were the first colonial empire in the century to abolish slavery, doing so in 1834.

Title: Scientist
Blurb: The 19th century saw the birth of science as a profession; the term scientist was coined in 1833 by William Whewell, which soon replaced the older term of natural philosopher.

Title: Athens
Blurb: The Kingdom of Greece moves its capital from Nafplio to Athens.

Title: Caucasus
Blurb: 1834-1859: Imam Shamil's rebellion in Russian-occupied Caucasus.

Title: Republic of Maryland
Blurb: The Republic of Maryland is established. Harper is the capital.

Title: San Salvador
Blurb: The Federal Republic of Central America moves its capital from Guatemala City to San Salvador.

Title: Texas
Blurb: Texas Revolution results in Texas's independence from Mexico, from 1835 to 1836.

Title: Republic of Indian Stream
Blurb: The Republic of Indian Stream is annexed by the United States of America.

Title: Mexican Republic
Blurb: The Mexican Republic supersedes the United Mexican States.

Title: United Tribes of New Zealand
Blurb: James Busby and 34 northern Maori chiefs sign He Whakaputanga resulting in the creation of the United Tribes of New Zealand. Its capital was Waitangi.

Title: Colt Paterson revolver
Blurb: 1836: Samuel Colt popularizes the revolver and sets up a firearms company to manufacture his invention of the Colt Paterson revolver, a six bullets firearm shot one by one without reloading manually.

Title: Republic of South Peru
Blurb: The Republic of South Peru secedes from the Peruvian Republic. Cusco is the capital.

Title: Riograndense Republic
Blurb: The Riograndense Republic declares independence from Brazil. Piratini is the first of five provisional capitals.

Title: Canada
Blurb: 1837-1838: Rebellions of 1837 in Canada.

Title: Telegraphy
Blurb: Telegraphy patented.

Title: Trail of Tears
Blurb: 1838: By this time, 46,000 Native Americans have been forcibly relocated in the Trail of Tears.

Title: Costa Rica, Nicaragua and Honduras
Blurb: The Republic of Costa Rica, the Republic of Nicaragua, and the Republic of Honduras secede from the Federal Republic of Central America. San Jose, Managua, and Comayagua are the respective capitals.

Title: Pitcairn Island
Blurb: The United Kingdom annexes Pitcairn Island.

Title: Belgrade
Blurb: The Principality of Serbia moves its capital from Kragujevac to Belgrade.

Title: Durand line
Blurb: 1839-1919: Anglo-Afghan Wars lead to stalemate and the establishment of the Durand line.

Title: Qing China
Blurb: First Opium War begins, lasting from 1839 to 1842.

Title: Peru-Bolivian Confederation
Blurb: Chile and Peruvian dissidents win decisively the Battle of Yungay against the Peru-Bolivian Confederation, starting the fall of the union.

Title: Grand Duchy of Luxembourg
Blurb: The Grand Duchy of Luxembourg becomes independent, but remains in personal union with the Netherlands as a result of the Treaty of London.

Title: Peruvian Republic and Bolivian Republic
Blurb: The Peruvian Republic and the Bolivian Republic are formed from the dissolution of the Peru-Bolivian Confederation. Lima and Sucre (previously Chuquisaca) are the respective capitals.

Title: Austin
Blurb: The Republic of Texas establishes its permanent capital at Austin.

Title: Republic of Guatemala
Blurb: The Republic of Guatemala secedes from the Federal Republic of Central America. Guatemala City is the capital.

Title: United Tribes of New Zealand
Blurb: The Treaty of Waitangi is signed resulting in the disestablishment of the United Tribes of New Zealand.

Title: Colony of New Zealand
Blurb: The colony of New Zealand is separated from the British colony of New South Wales.

Title: Dinosaur
Blurb: The word dinosaur is coined by Richard Owen.

Title: Hong Kong Island
Blurb: The United Kingdom conquers Hong Kong Island from the Qing dynasty.

Title: Republic of El Salvador
Blurb: The sole remnant of the Federal Republic of Central America changes its name back to the Republic of El Salvador.

Title: United Province of Canada
Blurb: The United Kingdom unites Upper Canada and Lower Canada as the Crown Colony of the United Province of Canada. Kingston is the capital.

Title: Kingdom of Sarawak
Blurb: James Brooke establishes the Kingdom of Sarawak. Kuching is the capital.

Title: Republic of Yucatan
Blurb: The Republic of Yucatan declares itself independent from Mexico. Merida is the capital.

Title: Anesthesia
Blurb: Anesthesia used for the first time.

Title: United States and British North America border
Blurb: The Webster-Ashburton Treaty comes into effect, ending several border disputes between the United States of America and the United Kingdom.

Title: Oregon Trail
Blurb: 1843: The first wagon train sets out from Missouri.

Title: Montreal
Blurb: The United Kingdom moves the capital of the Crown Colony of the United Province of Canada from Kingston to Montreal.

Title: Rochdale
Blurb: 1844: Rochdale Society of Equitable Pioneers establish what is considered the first cooperative in the world.

Title: Babism
Blurb: The Bab announces his revelation on 23 May, founding Babism. He announced to the world the coming of He whom God shall make manifest, and is considered the forerunner of Baha'u'llah, the founder of the Bahai Faith.

Title: Baltimore-Washington telegraph line
Blurb: First publicly funded telegraph line in the world, between Baltimore and Washington, sends a demonstration message on 24 May, ushering in the age of the telegraph. This message read What hath God wrought.
Place: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

Title: Dutch colonies in the Americas
Blurb: The Netherlands splits its colonial possessions in the Americas into two parts: Suriname and Curacao and Dependencies. Paramaribo remains the capital of Suriname, while Willemstad on Curacao becomes the capital of the six Caribbean islands.

Title: Honolulu
Blurb: The Kingdom of Hawaii moves its capital from Lahaina to Honolulu.

Title: Ireland
Blurb: 1845-1849: The Great Famine of Ireland leads to the Irish diaspora.

Title: Stanley
Blurb: The United Kingdom moves the capital of the Falkland Islands from Port Louis to Stanley.

Title: Riograndense Republic
Blurb: The Riograndense Republic is reabsorbed by the Brazilian Empire as the province of Rio Grande do Sul again.

Title: Republic of Texas
Blurb: The Republic of Texas joins the United States of America as the State of Texas. Austin yields to Washington as federal capital while remaining capital of the state.

Title: Mexico
Blurb: Mexican-American War leads to Mexico's cession of much of the modern-day Southwestern United States, from 1846 to 1848.

Title: North Australia
Blurb: The colony of North Australia is separated from the British colony of New South Wales.

Title: Oregon Country
Blurb: The Oregon Treaty establishes the 49th parallel north, from west of the Lake of the Woods, as the continental border between the Province of Canada and the United States of America.

Title: United Mexican States
Blurb: The United Mexican States supersedes the Mexican Republic.

Title: Neptune
Blurb: In astronomy, the planet Neptune was discovered.

Title: Free City of Cracow
Blurb: After the Krakow Uprising, the Free City of Cracow is annexed by the Austrian Empire.

Title: North Australia
Blurb: The British colony of North Australia is reincorporated back into the colony of New South Wales.

Title: Chloroform
Blurb: Chloroform invented for the first time, given to Queen Victoria at the birth of her eighth child, Prince Leopold, in 1853.

Title: Republic of Liberia
Blurb: The African-American colony of Liberia declares its independence as the Republic of Liberia. Monrovia is the capital.

Title: Apsheron Peninsula
Blurb: The first modern oil well was drilled in 1848 by the Russian engineer F.N. Semyonov, on the Apsheron Peninsula north-east of Baku.

Title: Europe
Blurb: The Revolutions of 1848, a series of democratic and liberal upheavals across Europe aimed at removing monarchical structures and creating independent nation states. Beginning in Sicily in January and spreading after France's February revolution, they affected over 50 countries.

Title: French Algeria
Blurb: French Algeria is made an integral part of France.

Title: French Second Republic
Blurb: February Revolution overthrew Louis Philippe's government. The Second Republic was proclaimed; Louis Napoleon, nephew of Napoleon I, was elected president.

Title: Kazakh Khanate
Blurb: The Kazakh Khanate loses its sovereignty to the Russian Empire.

Title: Sikh Empire
Blurb: Sikh Empire is defeated in the Second Anglo-Sikh War, from 1848 to 1849. Therefore, the entire Indian subcontinent is under British control.

Title: The Communist Manifesto
Blurb: Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels publish The Communist Manifesto.

Title: California
Blurb: 1848-1855: California Gold Rush.

Title: Northern Mexico
Blurb: The Mexican-American War ends with the Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo, by which the United Mexican States cedes all of its northernmost territories to the United States of America.

Title: Seneca Falls
Blurb: 1848: Seneca Falls Convention is the first women's rights convention in the United States and leads to the battle for women's suffrage.
Place: Seneca Falls, New York, United States

Title: Grand Duchy of Posen
Blurb: The Grand Duchy of Posen is fully incorporated into the Kingdom of Prussia and becomes the Province of Posen.

Title: Toronto
Blurb: The United Kingdom moves the capital of the Crown Colony of the United Province of Canada from Montreal to Toronto.

Title: Venice
Blurb: 1849: Earliest recorded air raid, as Austria employs 200 balloons to deliver ordnance against Venice.

Title: Roman Republic
Blurb: Rebels under Giuseppe Garibaldi take over the area of the Papal States and create the Roman Republic.

Title: Sikh Empire
Blurb: Following the Sikh defeat in the Second Anglo-Sikh War, the Sikh Empire falls and is merged with British India.

Title: Papal States
Blurb: The Papal States are restored as Rome falls.

Title: Hungarian State
Blurb: The Hungarian State capitulates to the Austrian Empire and the former status quo is restored.
